newsitem.title: UK: New emerging market appointments at Salomon, MAM.
newsitem.headline: New emerging market appointments at Salomon, MAM.

text.p: Mercury Asset Management (MAM) said former Baring Asset Management strategist David Soden has joined as a director of its International division, while Salomon Brothers has appointed Danielle Downing as equity strategist for emerging Europe.
MAM said Soden will work with Ewen Cameron Watt, head of its emerging markets desk.

Salomon's Downing will cover the high-growth markets of Europe, including Turkey, Poland, Greece, Hungary and the Czech and Slovak Republics. She will also cover Russia, the Middle East and North Africa.

Before joining Salomon, Downing spent six years in Russia. From 1990-91, she coordinated the establishment of the Moscow Commodity Exchange and most recently was at Alliance Manatep, the investment banking affiliate of Menatep Bank in Moscow.
